label: Noir
description: Dark ground, oversized headlines and a warm amber accent. Built for a room with the lights down and one idea per slide.
guidance: Choose this for a stage talk rather than a working session. It punishes dense slides: keep to a Statement or a Title plus at most three Grid cells, and prefer Stat over prose for numbers. Set `dark={false}` on a slide to invert it for emphasis, which reads as a hard cut rather than a transition.
